**Table name: `memo_relation`**

This table is defined and used across the store layer, e.g.:

```12:39:/bench/repo/store/db/sqlite/memo_relation.go
func (d *DB) UpsertMemoRelation(ctx context.Context, create *store.MemoRelation) (*store.MemoRelation, error) {
	stmt := `
		INSERT INTO memo_relation (
			memo_id,
			related_memo_id,
			type
		)
		VALUES (?, ?, ?)
		ON CONFLICT(memo_id, related_memo_id, type) DO UPDATE SET type = excluded.type
		RETURNING memo_id, related_memo_id, type
	`
```

It has columns `memo_id` (the source memo), `related_memo_id` (the linked memo), and `type` (the relation type). Equivalent implementations exist in `/bench/repo/store/db/postgres/memo_relation.go` and `/bench/repo/store/db/mysql/memo_relation.go`, and the Go struct is defined in `/bench/repo/store/memo_relation.go`.
